_doc: Armour, shield, ring and amulet rules (bug bash 3.3.2; docs/design/ARMOR_REDESIGN_PLAN.md, revision 3; numbers from tools/balance/armor_model.py). The floor only decides which level is likely to be found; every magnitude is fixed per level (LORE NOT FLOOR).

levels._doc: Enchantment level 1-10 (0 = plain). Tier = ceil(level / 2): the quiz tier and the plus on body armour and shields. Each level is drawn by a bell by floor; a level cannot appear before its first floor.

loot_split._doc: What a find of common gear is (Brandon's ruling, revision 2: armour has seven more slots than a weapon, so as many armour pieces as weapons): weapon / armour / shield. An armour find is any of the eight slots, evenly (pick_random_armor_for_floor). Floor rooms, monster drops and chests' gear all roll it (gear.pick_gear_class).

weight_class_bells._doc: Which weight class of template a find is, by floor: [peak, spread, first floor]. Plate on floor 3 was the early-AC spike of the first model pass.

threshold._doc: Complexity and benefit set the threshold (Brandon's ruling): complexity is the weight class, benefit the tier; a named unique asks one more; at most max.

accessory_threshold._doc: Rings, amulets and belts (history): complexity by slot, benefit by tier, same cap.

enchant_cap._doc: The most plus an Enchant Armour scroll can raise a core piece to; a minor piece's scroll raises its enchantment one level instead.
